chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinanī, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who did not know to enter the state of Ihram until he had entered the Haram (sanctuary of Mecca). What should he do? He (peace be upon him) said: He should exit the Haram, then he should commence with the Talbiyah for Hajj.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.الْحَرَمَ: The Haram (the sacred sanctuary of Mecca)
key_terms.يُحْرِمَ: To enter the state of Ihram (ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah)
key_terms.يُهِلُّ: To commence with the Talbiyah (the ritual invocation 'Labbayk Allahumma Hajj')

ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do if they enter Mecca without Ihram?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) addresses the specific case of *jahal* (ignorance) regarding the timing of Ihram, distinguishing it from intentional omission. It establishes that the pilgrim must exit the Haram boundary to perform the initial Tawaf al-Qudum or Umrah Ihram before re-entering, a procedure rooted in the Hanafi and Shia juristic understanding of the Miqat's function as a threshold for consecration. This highlights the Shia emphasis on precise ritual order (*tartib*) while accommodating human error in religious practice.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about a man who did not know that he should be wearing Ihraam until he entered the Harram. What should he do?’ Heasws said: ‘He should go out from the Harram, then he should commence with the Hajj’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from abu al-Sabbah al-Kinaniy who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who is ignorant of Ihram until he enters al-Haram (the sacred area) and about what he should do. He (the Imam) said, ‘He must go out of al- Haram (the sacred area), then say Talbiyah for al-Hajj.’”
